name: Lower Merion Playground Activities Camp
description_short: Six week township playground camp, 9:00 to 3:00 on weekdays, for kids 6 and up who have finished kindergarten, run at four Lower Merion parks. Days are crafts, games, group activities and special events, with some optional paid day trips.

sessions.name: Six week program (no program July 3, half day July 31)

notes: 2026 six week fee: non-residents $600, Lower Merion residents $500 (Narberth counts as non-resident). Limited to 75 campers. Sites: General Wayne Park (Merion Station), McMoran Park (Bala Cynwyd), South Ardmore Park and Wynnewood Valley Park (Wynnewood); the address shown is South Ardmore Park. Cancelled in bad weather. Registration opened February 2 for residents and February 16 for non-residents. 2027 not yet posted.
